title: Key Laboratory of Rubber-Plastics, Qingdao University of Science and Technology
content: Aerogel University Research Platform. The Key Laboratory of Rubber-Plastics at Qingdao University of Science and Technology is a university laboratory focused on polymers, plastics, rubber, and composites. Its official reports include graphene aerogel research, making it relevant for aerogel-related materials processing, development, and performance study.
